+"""Record preparation steps built on click utilities."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import typing as t
+
+from click.utils import make_str
+
+
+def to_display(value: t.Any) -> str:
+    """Convert a value to its display string using click's make_str."""
+    return make_str(value)
+
+
+def validate_record(record: t.Any) -> tuple[str, t.Any, bool]:
+    """Validate a raw record and return (trimmed key, value, enabled)."""
+    if not isinstance(record, dict):
+        raise ValueError("record must be a dict")
+    key = record.get("key")
+    if not isinstance(key, str) or not key.strip():
+        raise ValueError("record key must be a nonempty string")
+    if "value" not in record:
+        raise ValueError("record must have a value")
+    enabled = record.get("enabled", True)
+    if not isinstance(enabled, bool):
+        raise ValueError("record enabled must be a bool")
+    return key.strip(), record["value"], enabled
+
+
+def prepare(record: t.Any) -> dict[str, t.Any]:
+    """Return a new prepared record with key, value, display and enabled."""
+    key, value, enabled = validate_record(record)
+    return {
+        "key": key,
+        "value": value,
+        "display": to_display(value),
+        "enabled": enabled,
+    }

@@ -36,3 +36,18 @@ def prepare(record: t.Any) -> dict[str, t.Any]:
         "display": to_display(value),
         "enabled": enabled,
     }
+
+
+def batch(records: t.Any) -> list[dict[str, t.Any]]:
+    """Prepare a list of records in order, rejecting duplicate trimmed keys."""
+    if not isinstance(records, list):
+        raise ValueError("records must be a list")
+    prepared = []
+    seen: set[str] = set()
+    for record in records:
+        item = prepare(record)
+        if item["key"] in seen:
+            raise ValueError(f"duplicate record key: {item['key']!r}")
+        seen.add(item["key"])
+        prepared.append(item)
+    return prepared
